integrity: The primary source was inspected at the definitions of A_n and B_n, Lemma A.2, its computational-range statement, Lemma A.5, and the conditional degree-n equation. The infinite tail is proved analytically. Only the finite block 3<=n<=13 is delegated to a bundled exact-rational certificate; no floating-point computation is used there.
scientific_limitations: The result settles the branch-selection inequality for the explicit lower-bound constant constructed in the source. It neither improves the source's geometric input inequalities nor identifies the optimal area-versus-displacement constant.
title: All-dimensional branch selection for the antipodal-distance constant
